description: Parameters consumed by the reproducible build comparison stage.

parameterGroups.name: Stage Selections
parameterGroups.description: Boolean flags that control which pipeline stages are enabled. All stage-gate parameters are collected here so operators can see and adjust the full execution plan in one place.

parameters.name: RUN_REPRODUCIBLE_COMPARE
parameters.description: Run the reproducible build comparison stage. Requires SCM_REF to be set. Downloads the corresponding production Adoptium binary and diffs it against the locally produced build. Disabled by default.
